messages:
Olivia (SecOps): Heads-up @here — during tonight's export run we detected inconsistent customer-managed KMS key policies for a handful of Private deployments. Some CMKs are denying Redwood's service principal decrypt access. We saw export failures for snapshots. Need verification + remediation window tonight.
Raj (Infra): How many customers affected? Is this a rollout regression or onboarding gap?
Olivia (SecOps): Roughly 7 tenants flagged by the bulk-check script. Not a rollout change — looks like onboarding/terraform templates that never set the key IAM for our service principal.
Neil (Oncall): Customer-visible? any outages?
Olivia (SecOps): Two customers had failed nightly exports (502 from export-service). No data leakage, it's an access deny. We should treat as P2 — fix is straightforward but requires customer action for their CMKs.
Security Bot: INC-2026-314 created, severity=P2, assignees=secops+infra
Raj (Infra): Ok. Steps for infra/eng to validate keys: run the KMS policy check below (GCP example). Replace placeholders per-customer.
Raj (Infra): ```
# list keys
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=customer-keyring --project=customer-project
# get IAM policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy customer-key --location=global --keyring=customer-keyring --project=customer-project
``` 
Olivia (SecOps): Expected policy must include a binding allowing our service account to decrypt/encrypt. Example binding (GCP): `serviceAccount:redwood-infra@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. For AWS KMS customers, the key policy must allow `kms:Decrypt` for the role/Principal we provide during onboarding.
Neil (Oncall): I'll add a short runbook entry to the incident and triage any live customer alerts. Runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-policy-check>
Sara (Customer Success): I'll DM affected customers with a template and offer a 1-hour window for us to validate with them. Template msg: "Hey — we saw your KMS key policy is missing Redwood's decrypt permission, which blocks nightly backups. Please add the recommended binding (instructions attached). If you want, we can join a quick call and apply the change together." I'll post details in the ticket.
Jen (Product): Is this something we can catch earlier in onboarding? Maybe a policy validator step.
Olivia (SecOps): Yes — short-term: manual outreach + per-customer check. Mid-term: add automated policy validation during Private provisioning and include a preflight check in the onboarding CLI. I filed: ENG-OPS-987 to track.
Raj (Infra): I'll spin up a small tool to query key policies across tenants and produce a delta report. Draft PR: https://githublink/redwood/infra/pull/456 (WIP).
Olivia (SecOps): Thanks. Oncall please escalate if any other customer starts seeing decrypt errors. We'll run the remediation window 21:00-22:00 UTC tonight; CS will coordinate slots. 
Neil (Oncall): Acknowledged. I'll be on standby 21:00-22:30 UTC and will ping #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Sara (Customer Success): Sending first batch of DMs now. Will update thread with confirmations.
Olivia (SecOps): Appreciate it — after fixes we'll run an end-to-end export test and close INC-2026-314. :white_check_mark:
